subject.title: fix(msteams): preserve inbound activities before webhook ack

question: Should this protected Microsoft Teams delivery-path change be accepted after current-base validation and redacted live durability/restart proof?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes acknowledgement timing and replay ownership for an existing channel, so source-level tests cannot alone establish the upgrade and operational behavior maintainers want to support.

options.title: Require current-base live proof
options.body: Rebase, fix the lint failure, and require redacted evidence that a real Teams webhook is durably admitted before acknowledgement and is replayed once after restart.

options.title: Accept test-only confidence
options.body: Land based on the supplied automated suite claims while explicitly accepting that real Teams acknowledgement and replay behavior was not independently demonstrated.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Keep the branch open until a Microsoft Teams owner can validate the desired delivery and retry semantics in a live environment.

recommendation.title: Require current-base live proof
recommendation.body: Rebase, fix the lint failure, and require redacted evidence that a real Teams webhook is durably admitted before acknowledgement and is replayed once after restart.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent implementation contributor for the adapter and the branch’s lifecycle-race corrections; ownership confidence is limited because current-main history could not be independently inspected.
